meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续监控一个 Pull Request，直到所有检查通过、评论和审查线程都解决，可以合并为止。它会定期检查状态、阅读新评论、修复代码问题并推送提交。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 照看、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI 状态，直到所有问题解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我照看这个 PR #42，直到可以合并。
say.note: Claude 会开始监控该 PR 的状态。

say.text: 监控当前 PR 的审查线程和 CI 状态。
say.note: Claude 会检查未解决的审查线程和 CI 检查。

howto.what_en: Claude will continuously monitor a pull request until all checks pass, comments and review threads are resolved, and it is ready to merge. It periodically checks status, reads new comments, fixes code issues, and pushes commits.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #42 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: Claude will start monitoring the PR status.

say_en.text: Monitor the current PR's review threads and CI status.
say_en.note: Claude will check unresolved review threads and CI checks.
